# Original Bangla voices restored

On 23 November 2026, all 80 original cached recordings were restored byte for byte at the user’s request. No new audio was generated and no paid service was used.

The original synthetic voices are Microsoft bn-BD-PradeepNeural (male) and bn-BD-NabanitaNeural (female), originally generated with edge-tts 7.3.1. The twenty story clips use -5% synthesis rate; the sixty answer-reaction clips use -3%. Original timing and scripts are retained, without pitch effects or post-generation speed changes.

voices-data.js and reactions-data.js embed the MP3s locally. dialogue-copy.js and reactions-data.js supply matching Bangla subtitles. Playback is fully offline, with replay/stop in the conversation and volume in Settings. These are synthetic voices, not voice-actor recordings.

Voice information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/language-support
